tools.name: find_fashion_items
tools.description: Find where to buy fashion seen in a user-provided photo, screenshot, direct image URL, social post, blog, or product page. Use when the user asks to identify clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry, or accessories; shop an outfit; compare retailers; or find cheaper or second-hand matches. Returns current reg

tools.name: watch_item
tools.description: Persistently add a specific fashion product URL to the connected user's Remode watch list for lower-price or second-hand monitoring. When the supplied product is explicitly marked in_stock=false, the same watch also detects a restock; never infer stock state. Use when the user explicitly asks to wat

tools.name: get_watch_updates
tools.description: Read the linked user's active Remode watches and verified recent updates. Use when the user asks what Remode is watching or whether anything changed.

tools.name: update_watch
tools.description: Change whether an existing Remode watch looks for lower prices, second-hand matches, or both. Requires the stable watch_id returned by Remode.

tools.name: stop_watching_item
tools.description: Stop an existing Remode watch. Use only after the user asks to stop tracking an item. Requires the stable watch_id returned by Remode.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?platform=mcp_registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_item · Public sink: find_fashion_items.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_item · Public sink: find_fashion_items

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_fashion_items" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Identify, compare, and shop fashion from an image or link. Use for clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry, or accessories in uploaded photos, layered outfits, screenshots, direct image URLs, and TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest, blog, or product links. Remode returns shopping-relevant matches with live retailer" → after: "Find where to buy fashion seen in a user-provided photo, screenshot, direct image URL, social post, blog, or product page. Use when the user asks to identify clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry, or accessories; shop an outfit; compare retailers; or find cheaper or second-hand matches. Returns current reg"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
